observations: SDL_GetWindowSize returns cached window->w/h. SDL_GetWindowDisplayScale returns cached window->display_scale.
Cocoa_GetWindowSizeInPixels reads cached viewport size without updating layer/window geometry; its output was unconditionally overwritten in the old full query.

SDL_GetDisplayForWindow updates an SDL2-compat preferred-fullscreen-display property. This engine uses SDL3 directly through SDLCompat_SetWindowFullscreen(bool), rather than an SDL2-compat fullscreen consumer. Full geometry/placement queries remain unchanged.
No dependency on the removed calls to refresh CAMetalLayer.drawableSize was found in these inspected functions. Actual display/Space transitions remain outside hidden validation.
